risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and well quantified, including segment-level revenue, margin, expense, liquidity, and capital expenditure data. Risk tone is moderately negative because the pandemic caused substantial annual revenue and earnings declines, while fourth-quarter recovery and restored dividends provide some confidence. Forward-looking language appropriately highlights material exposure to automotive demand, raw materials, labor costs, supply disruptions, and customer concentration.
